title: Chinta Mani Library v2.3.0 (Build 32) — Multicolour 3D Bottom Bar, Reorganized Scan QR & Everyday Live Attendance Checker
releaseNotes: Reorganized Bottom Navigation Bar: Brand new animated 3D graphics & icons in original multicolours (Sky Blue, Emerald, Amber, WhatsApp Green, Royal Violet — NO golden styling) with spring scale interactions and ambient color glows
Streamlined Dashboard Quick Access: Reconfigured to 4 primary cards (Add Member, Record Fee, Universal QR, Insights) for balanced and ergonomic access
Removed Universal QR Card from Main Dashboard: Cleaned dashboard view per operational preferences

Reorganized Scan QR Hub: Removed legacy tabs (Admission Poster, Scholar Pass QR, Scanner Simulation); now features the permanent Universal QR portal card alongside the new Member Self-Attendance Check-In card
Member Self-Attendance Submission: Members can submit attendance via mobile number or Member ID, immediately reflecting across the admin dashboard and live attendance stream

Everyday Live Attendance Checker: New dedicated screen in More menu displaying real-time Present vs Absent status for all active members with check-in timestamps, filters, and 1-tap attendance marking
Public Portal Self Check-In: Added 1-Tap Attendance Check-In directly on the public web portal with instant verification feedback
